headline: Gulveer Singh and Harjinder Kaur each secured silver medals for India on Day 5 of the Commonwealth Games 2026, boosting the nation’s tally.
Teen swimmer Anushka Yadav, a farmer’s daughter, set a new Indian national record, becoming the youngest ever holder of a national athletics mark.
Neeraj Chopra was named Best Male Athlete at the Indian Athletics Awards 2025, recognized as the nation’s top male track‑and‑field star.
Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya emphasized India’s ambition to host the 2036 Olympic Games, outlining the country’s strategic push in the upcoming years.
The Indian women’s cricket team secured qualification for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics after a decisive series win, confirming their spot at the upcoming Games.
Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya highlighted India’s ambition to host the 2036 Olympic Games, outlining strategic steps and infrastructure plans to win the bid.
The Board of Control for Cricket in India confirmed a three‑match T20I series against Afghanistan to be played in Delhi ahead of the Asian Games schedule.
At the Indian Athletics Awards 2026, javelin star Neeraj Chopra and 800m runner Parul Chaudhary were crowned Athletes of the Year for their outstanding performances.
